name: pptx
tagline_zh: PPT 文件一出现，它就能读、能改、能拼拆。连提取文字做邮件摘要这种边角活，也顺手包圆，不用再开别的工具。
tagline_en: Any .pptx in sight? Read, edit, merge, split—even extract text for emails. One skill to handle it all, no extra.
desc_en: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slid
why_zh: 别的工具只会生成新文件，它却把解析、修改、合并、拆分全收进一个技能，连提取文字做摘要这种边角活都包了。
why_en: Others only create; this one also parses, edits, merges, splits—even extracts text for side tasks. All-in-one, no extra tools.
